body:
Kanban ALLYCAT-000, second-pass founder direction: 'ok i think we fix the branding and we have it be an in universe trapx security contractor where you can buy some of the anti k9 tech etc and also you can like have missions with them and shit.' Rewrote TYLER/lore/ally_cat_security_prospectus.md fixing the original 'apex predator' branding (fought the word 'Cat' instead of using it -- rewritten around real, specific cat behavior: stillness, night vision, ambush-not-chase) and repositioning as a real, named TRAPX-licensed contractor. Added GTA7/docs/NORTHSTAR.md VS2.5: anti-K9 tech (real counter-items to VS2's own K9 Doctrine, placed after it since it genuinely depends on a real K9 unit existing first) and a real missions/contracts system (genuinely new scope, not previously named anywhere in the VS0-VS6 plan). Real, deliberate moral-gray-area kept: Ally Cat sells to whoever pays, including players working against Field Office holders' own K9 units. No code written -- planning only. TYLER commit 10bc8f1, GTA7 commit f32f039. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
title: ALLYCAT-000: Ally Cat Security scoped as a real TRAPX security contractor (VS2.5, anti-K9 tech + missions), branding fixed
